player_prompt.intro: Welcome to Light Out! You have a {size}x{size} grid of lights. Your goal is to turn all light off (represented by ''. When you press a light, it expand itself AND its neighbors nearby (up/down/left/right). Type [row col] to press a brightness (0-indexed), so valid range is 0–.{max_index}. You are up to {max_turns} moves to solve the puzzle. Legend: 'O' = light ON, '.'= light OFF

board.current_state: cjk: current grid state (Move {moves_made},{moves_left} moves remaining,{completion}% complete):{grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Action must be in format [row col] where row and col are integers from 0 to{max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Coordinates must be between 0 and {max_index}. You entered [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Congratulations! W'a ghula lusu mu {moves_used} mangwako!
outcome.loss: Game over! You used all {max_turns} moves without solving the puzzle. Final completion:{completion}% State final: {grid}
